description: Window controls and launcher commands. core:window:default already covers is-maximized and internal-toggle-maximize (what data-tauri-drag-region uses for double-click), but not dragging or resizing — an undecorated window needs those spelled out, or the drag region silently does nothing. dialog:allow-open lets the user point at an existing .minecraft, dialog:allow-save lets them choose where an export lands; nothing else from that plugin is granted.
